reviews.title: iPhone Duo doesn’t work on Lebara
reviews.body:
Having been a loyal customer with Lebara for several years, I decided to buy a new iPhone Duo, hoping to switch to a Lebara eSIM (the Duo does not have a physical sim slot). 
Although Lebara sell the iPhone Duo, after many wasted hours trying to get in touch with Lebara support, it turns out they don’t support the Duo!! They can sell you a £2,000 mobile phone, that won’t then work on their network. 
You could end up on a 24 month contract with a phone that doesn’t work. 
At best this is poor commercial practise. At worst…

reviews.title: You have to port out to get deals! And even then.........nope
reviews.body: So as a long time customer, you epect to be able to get the good deals - nope.  Lebara has joined the other negative companies that only give new deals to NEW customers.  Thanks.  OK - so you have to leave them........then join them again, port your number back as a "new customer" and then you can have the deal.....apart from you order it, it doesn't work.  I'm starting to give up on Lebara.  You can't even transfer the deal to your current number as you have to order a new sim to be a new customer..............shambles.
